title: French Fondue
description: A classic French dish, perfect for snacking and entertaining. Made with a rich, creamy fondue and served with a variety of dipping options.

ingredients.name: Fondue Cheese
ingredients.notes: A mix of Emmental and Gruyère

instructions: Heat the wine in a medium saucepan over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Gradually add the Fondue Cheese, stirring constantly until melted and smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in the Zesty Mustard and Irish Whiskey (if using).
Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot or a small ceramic bowl set over a candle warmer.
Serve immediately with dipping options such as bread, vegetables, and meats.
